tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
We are not responsible for non accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The bidder agrees and abides for all the terms and conditions, specifications in the tender document layed down by HAMUL Trust for the service of each or all the items in the e Procurement portal
Bid submitted without sample will considered to be rejected
Managing director or management of Hassan milk union reserves the right to accept either all the tender or reject all the tender without giving any reasons
The quantity mentioned is tentative it may increase or decrease
The bidders shall go through the bid document / notification before processing the EMD

Hassan Milk Union comes under essential services. HAMUL is handling MILK collected from Lakhs of Milk producing farmers, which is highly perishable commodity it is of paramount importance to ensure timely processing of the same. In order to ensure timely supply of goods and services and maintain continuous production, the technically qualified MSMEs shall submit E.M.D amount (either DD/RTGS/NEFT to HAMUL in the name of Managing Director, HCMPSUL., Hassan) prescribed in tender within 3 days of intimation from this office, in favour of Managing Director, Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Societies Union Ltd, Hassan. Otherwise the bids of such organization will not be considered for commercial opening & Technically qualified bidders who have submitted the E.M.D will be considered for commercial opening.
